name: Gory Beacon
body:
Source Heaven Unleashed pg. 55
Aura strong evil; CL
Slot none; Price 5,800 gp; Weight —
Description
The skull of this grim lanternUE bears several rivets. Its blast of heat functions only when a creature of the user’s type within 30 feet (including the user) is taking bleed damage.
